sources.title: VoiceMe: Personalized voice generation in TTS - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract Novel text-to-speech systems can generate entirely new voices that were not seen during training. However, it remains a difficult task to efficiently create personalized voices from a high-dimensional speaker space.
